prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop website composition, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design the PGKhata marketing homepage as a refined operational ledger for Indian PG owners. Composition option B: make the entire first viewport a full-width monthly collection register. A compact floating navigation sits above it. The headline and primary action are embedded into the register's oversized top-left cells, while a live sequence of tenant, itemized bill, WhatsApp sent, and paid columns sweeps across the rest of the viewport like a calm command board. A large ₹0 forever marker anchors the far right edge. Below the fold, reveal a quiet text-led section beginning, not a card grid.
Style/medium: production-grade web UI design comp, flat front-on website screenshot, interface-first and not an illustration
Composition/framing: desktop landscape; one dominant ruled board spanning nearly the full width; editorial headline integrated into the grid; varied cell scale; visually legible reading order; primary CTA immediately visible
Color palette: established PGKhata system only—warm paper #faf9f8, white #ffffff, ledger green #154212, hover green #2d5a27, ink #1a1c1c, muted gray-green #72796e, pale leaf #bcf0ae, semantic amber and red used only for status
Materials/textures: matte paper fields, crisp hairline rules, subtle printed-ledger cues, one soft downward ambient shadow for the active workflow row; no decorative gradients, glow, glass, noise, or photography
Typography: characterful editorial serif for the promise; compact grotesk sans for navigation, controls, ledger columns and numbers; fixed-width numerals
Text (verbatim): brand name PGKhata and headline Rent collection, without the chaos. only. Render all other copy as indistinct interface lines or concise data marks; Indian rupee symbols and believable amounts may appear.
Product proof: show the four-step add tenant → itemized bill → WhatsApp → track payment loop through the board itself; use illustrative Indian names/initials, room/bed references, amounts and Paid/Pending/Overdue statuses
Responsive implication: the board should clearly be capable of collapsing into prioritized vertical rows on phones
Constraints: no hero card, no bento grid, no icon-card section, no device mockup, no browser chrome, no fake testimonial, no invented customer claims, no watermark
